evaluations.user_story: As a football fan, I want to register or log in at app startup so that I can securely access LiveFootball features with my personal account.
evaluations.reasoning: Overall INVEST mean: 0.8083. The story has clear security and account-access value and mostly objective authentication/access-control acceptance criteria. Testability is strong, though 'any protected app feature' is broad.

evaluations.user_story: As a mobile football fan with limited connectivity, I want to access previously loaded content offline so that I can continue reading football information when the connection is poor or unavailable.

evaluations.user_story: As a mobile football fan using the app offline, I want server-dependent actions to be prevented so that I do not believe unsaved preferences or live refreshes have been applied when connectivity is unavailable.
